mapper.select:
SELECT c.course_id AS courseId, c.name AS name, c.description AS description, , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_place cp WHERE cp.course_id = c.course_id) AS placeCount, c.created_at AS createdAt,
FROM course c
ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.course_id DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
mapper.sql: COALESCE( c.main_image, (SELECT MIN(hi.object_key) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY hi.sort_order) FROM post_image hi JOIN post hp2 ON hp2.post_id = hi.post_id AND hp2.course_id = c.course_id AND hp2.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE hi.object_key LIKE 'course/%'), (SELECT MIN(hp.image_url) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY hcp.visit_order) FROM course_place hcp JOIN place hp ON hp.place_id = hcp.place_id WHERE hcp.course_id = c.course_id AND hp.image_url IS NOT NULL) ) AS heroImageKey
mapper.select:
SELECT c.course_id AS courseId, c.name AS name, c.description AS description, , c.share_code AS shareCode, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_place cp WHERE cp.course_id = c.course_id) AS placeCount, p.post_id AS postId, p.content AS postContent, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_image i WHERE i.post_id = p.post_id) AS imageCount, c.created_at AS createdAt, c.updated_at AS updatedAt, c.main_image AS mainImage,
FROM course c LEFT JOIN post p ON p.course_id = c.course_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE c.creation_type = 'SYSTEM' AND c.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.course_id DESC

SELECT c.course_id AS courseId, c.name AS name, c.description AS description, , c.share_code AS shareCode, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_place cp WHERE cp.course_id = c.course_id) AS placeCount, p.post_id AS postId, p.content AS postContent, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_image i WHERE i.post_id = p.post_id) AS imageCount, c.created_at AS createdAt, c.updated_at AS updatedAt, c.main_image AS mainImage,
FROM course c LEFT JOIN post p ON p.course_id = c.course_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE c.course_id = #{courseId,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND c.creation_type = 'SYSTEM' AND c.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT p.place_id AS placeId, p.name AS name, p.image_url AS imageUrl, f.floor_code AS floorCode, cp.visit_order AS visitOrder, cp.recommendation_reason AS recommendationReason FROM course_place cp JOIN place p ON p.place_id = cp.place_id JOIN floor f ON f.floor_id = p.floor_id WHERE cp.course_id = #{courseId,jdbcType=NUMERIC} ORDER BY cp.visit_order ASC
SELECT p.name FROM course_place cp JOIN place p ON p.place_id = cp.place_id WHERE cp.course_id = #{courseId,jdbcType=NUMERIC} ORDER BY cp.visit_order ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE course SET name = #{name,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, description = #{description,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE course_id = #{courseId,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND creation_type = 'SYSTEM' AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course_country (course_id, country_code) SELECT #{courseId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{countryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} FROM dual WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM course c WHERE c.course_id = #{courseId,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND c.creation_type = 'SYSTEM' AND c.deleted_at IS NULL)
mapper.update: UPDATE course SET main_image = #{mainImage,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE course_id = #{courseId,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND creation_type = 'SYSTEM' AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE course SET deleted_at = SYSTIMESTAMP, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE course_id = #{courseId,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND creation_type = 'SYSTEM' AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE post SET deleted_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE course_id = #{courseId,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND deleted_at IS NULL
